test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

The Principal said, “What a good performance, Sonu! You have won the competition.”

options.text: The Principal surprised Sonu with news of his good performance and winning the competition.
The Principal applauded that Sonu had performed well and declared that he had won the competition.
The Principal cried out to Sonu that he had good performance and he had won the competition.
The Principal told Sonu about his good performance and that he has won the competition.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The Principal applauded that Sonu had performed well and declared that he had won the competition."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in direct speech, which means it is reported exactly as it was spoken.
 
• To convert it into indirect speech, we need to change the tense of the reporting verb and the pronouns. 
 
• The given sentence is in the Present Perfect Tense.
 
• The rule for changing Direct Speech to Indirect Speech:​
 
 
• Present Perfect Tense Changes to Past Perfect Tense.
 
• Remove the inverted commas from the direct speech and replace them with an appropriate conjunction.
 
• The first person of the reported speech changes according to the subject of the reporting speech.
 
 
• ​Example: *She says, " Reena has come to see me."* (Direct Speech)
 
 
 
 

 * **She says that Reena had come to see her. *(Indirect Speech)

 
• 
 
The given sentence is "**What a good performance, Sonu!"** becomes **"that Sonu had performed well."**

 
 
• 
 
**"You have won the competition**" becomes** "he had won the competition."**

 
 
• The sentence can also be written as **"The Principal praised Sonu for his good performance and announced that he had won the competition."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
